name: John Deere Distribution Center - Hebron IN

fieldNotes.site: Greenfield site. John Deere purchased the 234-acre parcel SW of the I-65 / SR-2 (181st Ave) interchange near Hebron/Lowell IN in July 2024 for $7M and broke ground on the $125M, 1.2M-sq-ft warehouse/distribution center in late January 2026. As of the available ©2026 Airbus satellite imagery, the SW quadrant of the interchange is entirely undeveloped farmland (with a small pond / borrow area) - no graded building pad, no foundation, no truck infrastructure is visible. Nothing to audit yet.
fieldNotes.coords: Center estimate (41.2820, -87.3020) is the SW quadrant of the I-65 / SR-2 interchange where the 234-acre parcel sits per the address 2105 W 181st Ave. Roster-supplied coords (41.288631, -87.358717) plot ~5 km west of the interchange in unrelated farmland and were not used. Coordinates are approximate to the parcel, not a confirmed building.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - open agricultural land at the edge of the small towns of Hebron and Lowell, away from any dense metro fabric.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: 234 acres is the publicly reported parcel size; the eventual fenced perimeter / building footprint cannot be measured until construction is imaged.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur visible at the site; not expected for this DC (located for I-65 highway access). Low confidence.
fieldNotes.classificationFlags: All physical-layout flags defaulted to false / NONE / null because the facility does not yet exist in imagery. Re-audit once post-construction satellite imagery becomes available (facility expected to open within ~12 months of the Jan 2026 groundbreaking).

citations.claim: John Deere recently broke ground on a new distribution center near Hebron IN; facility anticipated to open in the next year.

verification.rationale: Real future Deere DC near Hebron IN ($125M, 1.2M sqft) but under construction; announced Jan 2026, ground just broken, not operating as of 2026-06.
